economics.oracle_scope: Idealized label-aware lower cost for fixed-t policies preserving every correct candidate on the same ordered stream; not a universal lower bound for policies allowed to discard successes
economics.threshold_scope: Every t-specific threshold chosen from archived admissible SOURCE-development options only
economics.token_scope: Completion tokens; excludes prompt, probe, verification, latency, FLOPs and energy
economics.iid_scope: Economic formulas condition on a task; attempts must be i.i.d. across attempts, but within-attempt cost and success may depend

geometry.learning_curve_scope: Fixed C=.01, fixed layer13 and PCA16; deterministic task subsets; not the original selected algorithm or a claim about optimal sample efficiency

hardware.timing_scope: Instrumented paired capture implementation benchmark, not a claim of policy latency savings

prefix_diagnostics.scope: Identical prompt and token prefix imply tied deterministic scores; partial collisions do not establish a causal explanation of transfer loss

interpretation: Observable mean NLL and margin retain much of the point-estimate within-task ranking; probability loss tells a different story
PCA and an anchored residual formulation reduce the original H+B deficit; neither establishes improvement over B
Stronger joint regularization alone did not resolve the deficit in the tested family
Weak score correlation is not evidence of useful incremental correctness information or conditional independence
Transferred high-retention thresholds lose correct candidates on a concentrated subset of tasks
The oracle measures conditional economic opportunity, not an implementable predictor or universal lower bound
limitations: Post-hoc comparisons; pointwise conditional bootstrap intervals without simultaneous coverage
No causal attribution to dimension, redundancy, or benchmark shift
The independent retention endpoint does not confirm the exploratory readout comparisons
No wall-clock policy savings, energy savings or FLOPs claims from tokens

heterogeneity.scope: Post-hoc fixed-scorer deletion diagnostics; not a refit or a significance test after each exclusion

post_hoc_similarity_cluster_sensitivity.scope: Post-hoc sensitivity: join prompt-similarity pairs flagged by the label-blind post-start audit; sole primary task-bootstrap unchanged

independent.approval_source: Explicit student approval; advisor review reported by student
independent.interpretation: Sole confirmatory endpoint is paired candidate retention at t8; all other comparisons are descriptive
limitations: One fixed model and one additional function-level benchmark sample
New locally unexposed tasks do not certify absence of pretraining contamination
Task bootstrap assumes exchangeable tasks; deterministic hash reservation is not a census
No target fitting, threshold revision, outcome-dependent replacement or significance stopping
Independent retention confirmation does not confirm original incremental-value or operational-benefit hypotheses
Token replay does not establish wall-clock policy savings

operational.timing_scope: Total includes prefill, decoding, gate, parsing and warm-checker RPC; excludes model loading and warmup
operational.components: Prefill/capture/classification/remainder partition the generation wall span; generation+parsing+verification+other partition total. Copy can wait for preceding GPU work; spans are not isolated kernel costs.
operational.limitations: Six known pilot tasks, three repeated timings per mode, fixed N=3. Descriptive variability, no robust speedup inference, no RTX4060 extrapolation.
